paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence has moved from the laboratory into the workplace, and its arrival has reignited an old debate about machines and jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能已从实验室进入工作场所，它的到来重新点燃了关于机器与就业的古老争论。

paragraphs.en: In the past, machines replaced human muscles. Today's AI, by contrast, is beginning to take on tasks that were thought to require human judgement.
paragraphs.zh: 过去，机器取代的是人类的肌肉。相比之下，今天的人工智能开始承担那些被认为需要人类判断力的任务。

paragraphs.en: Automation can destroy jobs, but it can also create them. When machines take over routine work, workers are freed to focus on more complex and creative activities.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化可以摧毁工作岗位，也可以创造工作岗位。当机器接管日常事务时，工人得以解放出来，专注于更复杂和更具创造性的活动。

paragraphs.en: The question is whether the transition will be smooth. History suggests that new technologies can cause painful disruption before their benefits spread widely.
paragraphs.zh: 问题在于这一转变是否顺利。历史表明，新技术在其益处广泛传播之前，可能先造成痛苦的冲击。

paragraphs.en: Education will be crucial. Workers whose skills become obsolete need the chance to learn new ones, and schools must adapt to teach the abilities machines cannot easily copy.
paragraphs.zh: 教育将至关重要。技能过时的工人需要学习新技能的机会，学校也必须调整，以教授机器难以复制的本领。

paragraphs.en: Whether AI proves to be a blessing or a burden will depend less on the technology itself than on the choices societies make about it.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能最终是福音还是负担，与其说取决于技术本身，不如说取决于社会围绕它所做出的选择。
